Class ContainerTabs.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.ContainerTabs.Builder
Enclosing class:
ContainerTabs
public static final class ContainerTabs.Builder extends Object
Builds one tab. Every part is optional; a tab with no icon is an empty tab.

  • Method Details

    • icon

      public ContainerTabs.Builder icon(ContainerTabs.Icon icon)
      The tab's icon, drawn by the mod every frame: anything at all (an item, a sprite, an animation, a model it turns itself), fitted to the box MenuKit gives it. MenuKit only says where the box is, and clips it with the tab as a group slides.

    • icon

      public ContainerTabs.Builder icon(Supplier<net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> item)
      The tab's icon, an item, read every frame, filling the icon box: 16 px on a full-size tab, smaller in proportion on a smaller one.

    • icon

      public ContainerTabs.Builder icon(net.minecraft.resources.Identifier sprite)
      The tab's icon, a GUI sprite of the mod's own (mymod:tab/backpack, under textures/gui/sprites/), filling the icon box, where an item icon goes.

    • size

      public ContainerTabs.Builder size(int width, int height)
      The tab's size: width across and height out from the frame, each at least 8. Default 26 by 25, vanilla's creative tab as a row has it. Every tab stands on the frame, so tabs of different heights share their line, and the row is as tall as its tallest.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when either is below 8

    • tooltip

      public ContainerTabs.Builder tooltip(Supplier<@Nullable net.minecraft.network.chat.Component> tooltip)
      The tab's tooltip, read every frame it is hovered. A \n in it starts a new line; for a list of lines return MKTooltip.joinLines(List). A null result shows none.

    • order

      public ContainerTabs.Builder order(int order)
      Where it goes in its row: lower is further left; ties go by id. Default 0.

    • edge

      public ContainerTabs.Builder edge(ContainerTabs.Edge edge)
      The edge its row stands on. Default ContainerTabs.Edge.CONTAINERS_TOP.

    • onClick

      public ContainerTabs.Builder onClick(Runnable action)
      What a left click on it does, with vanilla's click sound. Not run while it is disabled.

    • selectedWhen

      public ContainerTabs.Builder selectedWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Drawn selected, open into the frame, while this holds, read every frame. MenuKit keeps no selection.

    • visibleWhen

      public ContainerTabs.Builder visibleWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Shown while this holds, read every frame. Hidden, it takes no place in its row.

    • disabledWhen

      public ContainerTabs.Builder disabledWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Grayed and taking no click while this holds, read every frame. Its tooltip still shows.

    • pinnedWhen

      public ContainerTabs.Builder pinnedWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Pinned while this holds, read every frame: as the row is paged past it, it stops at the end of the row it would leave by, still clickable, and the tabs beyond it go on behind it. Paged forward, it stops at the left end until the next group's header pushes it off; paged back, at the right end, other groups' tabs going on behind it too, until the previous group's pinned tabs push it off. A group's pinned tabs, its header and any of its sub-tabs, stand there side by side in row order and leave together. In a nested group, a pinned tab pins the headers of the groups above its own too, and the whole chain stands and leaves together, pushed off by the next top group's header. A selected tab behind a pinned one is brought out from behind it. Pinning is a group's: a tab outside any group is pushed off by the tab after it, so it pages as before. Default: never.
